subject: Cross-vendor listing: catalog integration & launch playbook
messages:
From: Liam Murphy <liam.murphy@cloudbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalog integration: initial spec and launch timing

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for taking this on. CloudBridge has finalized the integration spec for a cross-vendor catalog entry that makes our connectors discoverable alongside ISV bundles in the AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces. Attached is the spreadsheet with the mapping we discussed (cloudbridge-integration-spec.xlsx).

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the SKU naming convention Redwood needs for co-listing and reseller entitlements (we have a draft mapping in the sheet).
- Walk through the catalog visibility gating (what evidence/Docs do you need for certification across AWS/GCP?).
- Confirm whether your private and dedicated offer models require separate listing artifacts or if we can reuse a single manifest.

We’re targeting a soft launch in the week of Nov 29 to align with a partner webinar Acme is running. Can we schedule a 45-minute working session this week to lock the back-to-back deliverables?

Attachments: cloudbridge-integration-spec.xlsx (xlsx, 78KB)

Thanks — looking forward to syncing.

— Liam Murphy
Partnerships, CloudBridge
liam.murphy@cloudbridge.com
+1 415 555 0191

--
Forwarded message (for context): the spec includes a tab per cloud and a requirements checklist per marketplace.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
To: Liam Murphy <liam.murphy@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalog integration: initial spec and launch timing

Thanks Liam — and thanks for the spec. I skimmed the spreadsheet and shared a short checklist with our go-to-market and product folks (see notes below). Happy to take the lead on the catalog manifest side and coordinate the cross-team tasks.

Quick clarifying Qs before the working session:
1) Revenue share / entitlement: will CloudBridge expect Redwood to include a reseller SKU or is this strictly a referral listing? If reseller, we’ll need legal to review the revenue share schedule (please confirm the % range).
2) Data residency: any customer data paths from your connector during onboarding we should flag for our Private deployment docs? (Acme typically requires EU data residency for demo tenants.)
3) Demo artifacts: do you have a pre-built demo VM or a containerized demo image we can host for marketplace listing pages?

Proposed attendees from Redwood: me (marketplace PM), Ben Carter (alliances lead), Olga Petrov (catalog ops), Vivek Kulkarni (technical partnerships).

I attached a brief doc (redwood-catalog-requirements.docx) that lists the marketplace evidence we usually surface for multi-cloud listings. Please review ahead of the call so we can triage items into an owner list.

I can do Wed 10/28 11:00am PT or Thu 10/29 2:30pm PT. Which works for you?

Attachments: redwood-catalog-requirements.docx (docx, 24KB)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Partnerships Program Manager | Redwood Inference
